files.name: dochi_spawn_control-0.1.4-forge-1.20.1.jar
files.html:
0.1.4 Change Log

  • Completely removed CustomNPCs (CNPC) as a required dependency.
  • Added support for DNPC clone templates (requires DNPC 0.1.1 or later).
  • Improved the UI.
